plans.title: My flight plans
plans.description: Flight plans prepared from your bookings.

empty.title: No flight plans yet
empty.description: A flight plan is prepared from a booking: open your bookings and choose “Create a flight plan”.
empty.filteredDescription: Change the search or the filters to find your flight plans.

updated.title: Flight plan updated
updated.description: The flight plan {{origin}} → {{destination}} has been updated.

updateFailed.title: Could not update
updateFailed.description: The flight plan could not be updated. Try again in a moment.

planDetail.title: Flight plan
planDetail.loadError: The flight plan could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

notFound.title: Flight plan not found
notFound.description: This flight plan does not exist or you do not have access to it.

beforeDeparture.title: Before departure
beforeDeparture.description: Check the NOTAMs and the weather, and make sure all the documents required for the flight are on board.

aircraftAndPilot.title: Aircraft and pilot
aircraftAndPilot.noAircraft: No aircraft is linked to this flight plan.

map.unavailableDescription: The aerodrome coordinates are not recorded for this flight plan.

planCreate.title: Create a flight plan
planCreate.descriptionDefault: The flight plan will be linked to your booking.

createFailed.title: Could not create
createFailed.description: The flight plan could not be created. Try again in a moment.
createFailed.accountNotLoaded: Your account is not loaded yet. Try again in a moment.

planEdit.title: Edit the flight plan
planEdit.description: {{origin}} → {{destination}}. To change the route, create a new plan.

waypointInfo.title: Waypoints
waypointInfo.description_one: {{count}} waypoint. Select a waypoint to locate it on the map.
waypointInfo.description_other: {{count}} waypoints. Select a waypoint to locate it on the map.
waypointInfo.empty: This flight plan has no detailed waypoints.

copied.title: Link copied
copied.description: The flight plan link is on the clipboard.

copyFailed.title: Could not copy
copyFailed.description: The link could not be copied. Copy the page address from your browser.

closeFlight.title: Close the flight
closeFlight.description: Confirm what was actually flown: the flight will be entered in your logbook.
closeFlight.loadError: The flight could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

notFound.title: Flight not found
notFound.description: This flight does not exist or you do not have access to it.

alreadyClosed.title: Flight already closed
alreadyClosed.description: This flight was closed on {{date}}. It is in your logbook; only an administrator can still amend it.

done.title: Flight closed
done.description: The flight is recorded in your logbook.
done.aircraftGrounded: The aircraft is grounded: it can no longer be booked until a technician or an administrator puts it back in service.

confirm.title: Close this flight?
confirm.description: The flight {{route}} will be entered in your logbook with {{duration}} of flight time. Once it is closed, only an administrator can amend it.
confirm.descriptionWithIncident: The flight {{route}} will be entered in your logbook with {{duration}} of flight time, and the incident will be reported to the club. Once it is closed, only an administrator can amend it.

noAircraft.title: The incident cannot be recorded
noAircraft.description: This flight is not linked to any aircraft, so the incident cannot be attached to one. The flight has not been closed.

closeError.title: The flight was not closed
closeError.description: Something went wrong while closing the flight. Try again in a moment.

exportError.title: Export failed
exportError.description: The PDF could not be generated. Try again in a moment.

details.intro: The values come from the flight plan: correct whatever changed during the flight.
details.flightTimeHint: This time is entered in your logbook.

notes.label: Remarks on the flight
notes.placeholder: E.g. three circuits at Pontoise, practice forced landing
notes.hint: They appear in the “Remarks” column of your logbook.

incident.occurred: An incident occurred during this flight
incident.occurredHint: Failure, defect, damage or safety occurrence. The report is sent to the club when the flight is closed.
incident.dateTime: Date and time of the incident
incident.descriptionPlaceholder: What happened, at what stage of the flight, in what conditions?
incident.damagePlaceholder: E.g. front left tyre flat, no other damage
incident.correctiveActionsPlaceholder: What has been done, or what remains to be done before the next flight
incident.groundingHint: A high-severity incident grounds the aircraft as soon as the flight is closed, until the club puts it back in service.

waypoints.unreadable: The waypoints of this plan cannot be read.

notStarted.title: This flight cannot be closed yet
notStarted.description: Its booking starts on {{date}}. You will be able to close the flight from then on.

noBooking.title: This flight is not attached to any booking
noBooking.description: Only an administrator can close a flight without a booking. Please contact the club.

bookingCancelled.title: The booking of this flight is cancelled
bookingCancelled.description: A flight whose booking is cancelled cannot be closed.

recapValidation.icaoLength: The ICAO code must be 4 characters long
recapValidation.severityRequired: The severity of the incident is required
recapValidation.descriptionRequired: The description of the incident is required
recapValidation.priorityRequired: The priority of the incident is required
recapValidation.categoryRequired: The category of the incident is required
recapValidation.flightHoursPositive: Enter a flight time greater than zero
recapValidation.flightHoursTooLong: The flight time cannot exceed {{max}} hours

logbook.title: Logbook
logbook.description: Your closed flights, your hours and how they break down.

export.errorDescription: The logbook PDF could not be generated. Try again in a moment.

noMatch.title: No matching flights
noMatch.description: No closed flight matches this period or these filters.

empty.title: Your logbook is empty
empty.description: A flight appears here as soon as it is closed from its flight plan.

closedAdmin.title: Closed flight — corrections are for administrators
closedAdmin.description: Closed on {{date}}, this flight of {{pilot}} counts {{duration}} in their logbook. A correction or a deletion updates their hours and is kept in the action log.

form.title: Correct the flight
form.hoursHint: In hours and minutes, for example 1:30 (or 1.5).
form.trace: The previous value is kept in the action log.

errors.hours: Enter a flight time above zero, for example 1:30.
errors.passengers: Enter a whole number of passengers, zero or more.
errors.arrival: The arrival must be after the departure.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this closed flight?
deleteConfirm.description: The flight {{route}} of {{pilot}} will be removed from their logbook, with its {{duration}}. The deletion is kept in the action log and cannot be undone.

updated.title: Flight corrected
updated.description: The pilot's logbook is up to date.

deleted.title: Flight deleted
deleted.description: The flight {{route}} was removed from the logbook.
